svg.aria-label: Captures of mediaman: menus open on top of a preview over the search sheet, a sideways phone Keep menu that plainly scrolls, a red ring on a wrong Profile email, and a title hero with no seam
svg.text: Menus open on top of the preview, and the glass reads cleaner
Captures of the built app at the sizes named.
Desktop, 1440×900: a preview opened from the search sheet. Its Keep menu (and its “…” menu) now opens on top of
the preview instead of under it, and the search sheet stays open behind.
Phone held sideways, 874×402: the Keep menu cuts its
last visible row in half, so it plainly scrolls.
Profile, phone: a wrong Email field rings red. Focus rings
on Profile fields and grid heads use the glass’s blue.
Title page, 1440×900: the hero fades into the page with
